security_privacy_cost_impact: NO SCHEMA, POLICY, GRANT OR ROLE CHANGES. Four read-only catalog probes, each in its own transaction via script(), failing migrate-clean where a later file weakens an FK action, a caller-binding closure, a SECURITY DEFINER search_path or a trigger. This strengthens the tenant and audit controls' defence against future change; it changes nothing they do today.
migration_and_data_impact: NONE. No migration; the set is unchanged at 000..140.
compatibility_impact: migrate-clean can now fail on a set it used to accept, by design. A future batch that adds a closure, a SECURITY DEFINER function, a trigger or an FK with an action must satisfy or extend the pinned lists in the same change (README). The closure pin compares PG 17's deparse; a Postgres major-version change in CI may require re-measuring it.
known_limitations: The closure pin is exact text; a different Postgres major version may deparse differently and fail it by name (the fix is to re-measure, not to loosen).
The survey's item 3 (eleven forging cases), items 5-7 (batch 150's own pins, vocabulary and narrowing text) and blocker 188's unasserted CHECKs, NOT NULLs, columns and FORCE remain owed.
The Owner's authority for the seven plan questions is a delegation given before they were written.
open_risks_or_blockers: NONE OPENED OR CLOSED (188). Two are narrowed: the name-or-token survey blocker (closures and FK actions discharged) and 188 (search_path and triggers discharged).
rollback_or_forward_fix: A reviewed revert PR removes the probes and returns migrate-clean to what it accepted before; no database object is involved. NEVER a force-push. A probe that fails for a legitimate change is extended in the same change as that change, never disabled.
recommended_next_work_packages: The eleven updated_by forging cases (survey item 3).
Before batch 150: 121's objects pinned by definition text in 150's own block (survey item 5).
